patch_description:
Prioritize locally observable additions that close triangles or duplicate a relationship across layers. Their exact marginal utility can be computed from current degree, common neighbors, cost, triangle benefit, and spillover benefit; the engine oracle verifies the best candidate before proposing it. When no such improvement exists, retain the original action routine, preserving its mature deletion, rewiring, and post-shock behavior.
For d>0.8 during early formation, permit each actor at most one bounded bridge-building sacrifice when the immediate loss is smaller than one potential triangle benefit. Recipients use the same one-sacrifice limit. This directly tests the documented coordination-barrier mechanism while bounding the cost of stranded paths. After time 40, all offers require strict recipient improvement, so shocks cannot trigger further speculative construction.
